argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 15
$r=@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.id -eq '9f434c35-9e28-4807-8d5f-18569e8bdcf5'})
if($r.Count -ne 1){throw 'CANARY_NOT_FOUND_OR_DUPLICATE'}
$t=$r[0]
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENT_STATE='+$t.state)
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENT_ID='+$t.id)
Write-Output ('DISPATCH_COUNT='+$t.dispatchCount)
Write-Output ('DISPATCH_SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED='+$t.dispatchSubmitAttempted)
Write-Output ('DISPATCH_FAILURE_CODE='+$t.dispatchFailureCode)
Write-Output ('PREFLIGHT_REASON='+$t.lastPreflightReason)
Write-Output ('LAST_DIAGNOSTIC='+([string]$t.lastDiagnostic).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(([string]$t.lastDiagnostic).Length,230)))
Write-Output ('QUEUED_AT='+$t.queuedAt)
Write-Output ('DISPATCH_STARTED_AT='+$t.dispatchStartedAt)
Write-Output ('RUNNING_AT='+$t.runningAt)
Write-Output ('AWAITING_EVIDENCE_AT='+$t.awaitingEvidenceAt)
Write-Output ('COMPLETED_AT='+$t.completedAt)
Write-Output ('CURRENT_HEAD='+$t.currentHead)
Write-Output ('CI_CONCLUSION='+$t.ciConclusion)
Write-Output ('OTHER_UNSETTLED='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.id -ne $t.id -and $_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
$d=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments/dry-run') -TimeoutSec 15
Write-Output ('DRY_NO_SEND='+($d.sendAttempted -eq $false))
Write-Output ('SELECTED_CHAT_COUNT='+@($d.selectedChatIds).Count)

note: Observe exact original QA canary assignment only, no duplicate dispatch, no chat IDs or credentials.
